title: 10 open source repos that turn Claude Code into a motion studio
prompt_text: HyperFrames, Remotion, Remotion Skills, GSAP, anime.js, Motion, Motion Canvas, MCP for Blender, three.js, After Effects MCP. Easiest start: HyperFrames or Remotion with its skills, GSAP for easing. Prompt animation principles: anticipation before the jump, squash on landing, follow-through on the ears.

title: AI video prompt recipe: subject, action, setting, camera, light
prompt_text: Recipe: subject + action + setting + camera + light. Example prompt: "A ceramic cup on a rainy cafe window ledge. Steam rises. Slow push-in. Soft morning light." Change one detail per test.

title: 6-second looping HTML animation with style variants
prompt_text: make a 6 second looping animation in html with a replay button. Then add one style: maps, paper cut, blueprint, kinetic type, liquid morph (e.g. "melt a circle into a star and back").

title: Japanese high school action drama classroom fight, 30-second prompt
prompt_text:
AI Video Prompt

Create a 30-second ultra-realistic cinematic Japanese school action drama set inside a modern high school classroom. A beautiful young adult woman with black hair tied in a ponytail wears a navy school blazer with orange piping, a white shirt, a striped tie, and a red-and-black plaid skirt. A rebellious young adult male student with messy bleached-blond hair wears a matching navy school uniform. Scene 1 (0–6 seconds): Establish the classroom with desks, chairs, large windows, and soft natural daylight. The girl sits quietly at her desk while the blond-haired boy lounges carelessly behind her. Use cinematic wide shots, close-ups of their faces, and shallow depth of field to build tension. Scene 2 (6–12 seconds): The boy provokes the girl. She suddenly turns toward him and strikes back with a powerful, controlled punch. Use a fast camera push-in, realistic body movement, and a brief slow-motion impact shot with subtle dust and motion effects. Scene 3 (12–20 seconds): An intense martial arts fight breaks out inside the classroom. The girl skillfully dodges punches, blocks attacks, and delivers fast counterattacks. The boy fights back aggressively. Desks and chairs shift as they move through the room. Use dynamic tracking shots, rapid cuts, low-angle shots, and realistic action choreography. Scene 4 (20–26 seconds): The fight reaches its climax. The girl executes a decisive counterattack, sending her opponent stumbling backward toward the classroom lockers and chalkboard. Other students lie scattered across the floor after the chaotic confrontation. Show realistic movement, dramatic camera angles, and cinematic impact effects without graphic injuries. Scene 5 (26–30 seconds): The classroom falls silent. The girl stands confidently among the overturned desks and defeated opponents. End with a dramatic close-up of her calm, determined face, loose strands of hair framing her eyes. Slowly push the camera toward her face for a powerful final shot. Visual Style: Photorealistic live-action, Korean school action drama aesthetic, cinematic lighting, natural skin texture, realistic facial expressions, detailed school uniforms, smooth motion, professional stunt choreography, 4K quality, dramatic atmosphere, consistent character appearances, seamless scene transitions. Camera & Sound: Dynamic handheld camera movement during fights, smooth cinematic tracking shots, shallow depth of field, punch impact sound effects, classroom ambience, dramatic background music, and a tense cinematic ending. Important: Maintain consistent character identity, clothing, hairstyles, classroom layout, and lighting throughout the entire video. No cartoon effects, no exaggerated facial distortions, no blood, no gore, no text, and no watermarks.
